description.zh: 给出几件各自消耗能量、带来收益的任务和一个能量预算，孩子从三个候选方案里选出符合要求的那一个。K1-K2 只要求选出不超预算的方案；G1-G2 升级为在预算内选出收益最高的方案，训练真正的权衡取舍而不只是不超支。
description.en: Given a handful of tasks that each cost energy and pay a reward, plus a fixed energy budget, the child picks the one candidate plan out of three that meets the goal. K1-K2 just needs a plan that stays within budget; G1-G2 raises the bar to the highest-reward plan that still fits, training real trade-offs rather than just avoiding overspend.

designModel.zh: 主轴是任务数量（task_count）与预算紧张度（budget_tightness），配合目标类型（goal_type：fit_only 只需不超支，maximize_reward 要在可行方案里选收益最高的）。三轴共同决定权衡计算的负荷。
designModel.en: The primary axes are task count (task_count) and how tight the budget is (budget_tightness), paired with the goal type (goal_type: fit_only just needs to stay within budget, maximize_reward needs the highest-reward option among the feasible ones). The three axes together set the trade-off load.

ageRange.noteZh: K1 两件任务、预算宽松适合 3-4 岁；G2 四件任务、预算最紧且要最大化收益约 7 岁。
ageRange.noteEn: K1's two tasks with a loose budget suit ages 3-4; G2's four tasks with the tightest budget and a maximize-reward goal suit about age 7.

seriesBoundary.policyZh: 本模块属小精灵系列 · 策略大师。训练的是『在固定资源上限下，从多个方案中选出满足约束或收益最高的那个』；与 RG.STRATEGY.DECISION.PLANNING 所训练的通用『多方案权衡+步骤排序』不同，本模块不涉及步骤先后顺序，只涉及资源约束下的取舍计算，也不涉及 spatial-pattern-hunter 等空间路径规划。
seriesBoundary.policyEn: This module belongs to MindSeeds · Strategy Master. It trains picking, under a fixed resource limit, the one plan among several that meets the constraint or pays the most. This differs from the general 'weigh options and order steps' skill behind RG.STRATEGY.DECISION.PLANNING — this module has no step ordering, only constrained trade-off arithmetic — and it does not involve spatial route planning as in spatial-pattern-hunter.

geneReporting.ruleZh: 每次 Attempt 上报 RG.STRATEGY.RESOURCE.TRADEOFF，不随等级变化。
geneReporting.ruleEn: Every attempt reports RG.STRATEGY.RESOURCE.TRADEOFF, regardless of grade.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 候选方案里出现的任务种类数量，从两件到四件。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: How many distinct tasks appear across the candidate plans, from two up to four.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: 预算相对任务总花费的宽松程度：loose 一眼能排除超支方案，tightest 需要仔细计算才能分辨。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: How tight the budget is relative to total task cost: loose plans can be ruled out at a glance, tightest ones need careful arithmetic to tell apart.

difficultyAxes.noteZh: fit_only 只需选出不超预算的方案；maximize_reward 要在所有可行方案里选收益最高的，真正的权衡取舍。
difficultyAxes.noteEn: fit_only only needs a plan that stays within budget; maximize_reward needs the highest-reward plan among all the feasible ones — a genuine trade-off.

sessionPolicy.noteZh: 一次 8 题，通过线 75%（6/8）。没有静态题库：generator.js 现生成，玩完立即换一批。
sessionPolicy.noteEn: Eight items per run, passing at 75% (6/8). No static bank: generator.js builds each set and a new one is swapped in when the run ends.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 两件任务、预算宽松，选出不超预算的方案。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Two tasks, a loose budget — pick the plan that stays within budget.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 三件任务、预算更紧，仍是选出不超预算的方案。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Three tasks, a tighter budget — still pick the plan that stays within budget.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 三件任务、预算紧张，在预算内选出收益最高的方案。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Three tasks, a tight budget — pick the highest-reward plan that still fits.

levelMap.objectiveZh: 四件任务、预算最紧，权衡出收益最高的方案。
levelMap.objectiveEn: Four tasks, the tightest budget — weigh trade-offs for the highest-reward plan.

statistics.noteZh: goalTypes 区分 fit_only 与 maximize_reward，能看出孩子是停在『不超支』还是已经能做真正的收益权衡。
statistics.noteEn: goalTypes separate fit_only from maximize_reward, showing whether the child stops at 'staying in budget' or can already do real reward trade-offs.
